title: Candle wick trimmer and snuffer set
description: A wick trimmer and a candle snuffer, the two tools that keep a candle at its best. Trim the wick to about 5 mm before each burn for a cleaner, steadier flame with less soot, and when you have finished, lower the snuffer over the flame rather than blowing it out, so there is no smoke and no spattered wax. Both are stainless steel with a black powder-coated finish and the Told London logo in white, and long enough to reach into a deep porcelain vessel. They come in a cotton bag printed with Kerry Lemon’s botanical drawings from the Wanderings Collection.

title: City Grandeur, London Candle Refill, 300g
description: City Grandeur is London: the energy of the city and the calm of its parks, held together. Composed by Ruth and Nic Mastenbroek, hand-poured in England, and made for the porcelain you already own, illustrated by Kerry Lemon. A fresh, cosmopolitan fragrance built around citrus and tea. It opens bright, with mandarin, lemon, lime and bergamot, then turns aromatic as rosemary and black tea move through a floral heart of ylang ylang and lily. Underneath, vetiver, moss, cedar and amber give it the cool green depth of a London park in summer.
